articles.title: 10 soldiers killed as vehicle falls into gorge in Doda
articles.summary: An Army vehicle transporting troops for an operation tragically slipped off the road and plunged into a deep gorge in Doda district, Jammu. The accident resulted in the immediate death of ten army personnel, with eleven others sustaining injuries. This unfortunate incident underscores the inherent dangers and challenging conditions faced by soldiers operating in difficult terrains.

articles.title: Probing the Mysteries of the Solar Corona with ESA’s Proba-3
articles.summary: ESA's flagship Proba-3 mission has showcased its capability as an 'on-demand, eclipse producing machine.' This innovative dual-satellite system is designed to create artificial total solar eclipses in space. This unique ability enables scientists to conduct unprecedented observations and gather crucial data for solar research, particularly studying the Sun's corona, which is usually only visible during rare natural eclipses, significantly advancing our understanding.

articles.title: France seizes suspected Russian 'shadow fleet' oil tanker in Mediterranean
articles.summary: The French Navy intercepted an oil tanker in the Mediterranean Sea, which had sailed from Russia and was operating in violation of international sanctions. French maritime authorities conducted the interception, highlighting global efforts to enforce economic restrictions against sanctioned entities. This incident demonstrates the role of naval forces in upholding international law and security, especially concerning maritime trade and geopolitical mandates.
